sources.entry: BingPaper - Use Bing daily photo as your wallpaper on macOS.

summary.one_liner: BingPaper is a macOS app that sets Bing's daily photo as your desktop wallpaper.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS application that uses Bing's daily photo as the desktop wallpaper. Its listed features include automatic download of new Bing images, automatic wallpaper changes, and display of each image's information. It can also reuse previously downloaded history images as wallpaper and lets the user choose the Bing region and the local storage location for images. Other listed options are showing or hiding the dock icon, automatic start at system startup, and dark mode. The README does not describe how the app is internally structured beyond the build steps.
use_cases: Set a daily Bing photo as desktop wallpaper on a Mac
Automatically rotate wallpaper with new Bing images
Browse and reuse past Bing wallpapers
Pick a regional Bing image feed
Run a menu-bar style wallpaper utility without a dock icon
how_to_run: Open the project in Xcode and press ⌘ + R to run, or ⌘ + B to build
Drag the built BingPaper.app into your /Applications folder
notable: Automatically downloads and rotates the Bing daily image as wallpaper
Keeps a history of Bing images that can be reselected
Lets the user choose the Bing region and image storage folder
Can hide the dock icon and start at login
caveats: The author did not sign the released app, so Gatekeeper must be disabled to run the download
Requires building with Xcode and CocoaPods for source builds
